data.description: Deterministic MCP retrieval by explicit overview, scope, search, ids and file/symbol bindings, including typed UML artifacts and separate UI mockups. Lifecycle startup uses a metadata-only SQL index bounded to 3,000 UTF-8 bytes and at most 32 candidate entries, with complete stable ids, element type/name/parent/version and included/total counts. Descriptions, relationships, source, artifacts and bindings are loaded through explicit relevant retrieval. Omission metadata identifies incomplete context; the MCP never infers a task's meaning. Shared retrieval workflow is documented in agents_template.md and on-demand operation help. Implemented contract: editable design-document reads return stable document identity, the complete canonical editable document, and a server-computed content-hash readToken from the same snapshot. Agents copy the opaque token unchanged into an update or delete. Partial overviews, indexes, or search snippets are not complete editable snapshots; their guidance directs the agent to retrieve the complete document before replacing it. Explicit get_by_ids, get_scope, and get_bindings responses include documents entries; get_documents retrieves exact documentIds. Each entry contains documentId, document, and readToken. Overview and search remain navigation-only.
data.name: Formal Design Retrieval API
